parameters.query: SELECT n.id, n.patient_id, n.horodatage, n.auteur, n.categorie, n.texte, r.civilite, r.prenom, r.nom, r.chambre FROM soins.notes_soins n JOIN soins.residents r USING (patient_id) WHERE n.horodatage > now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY n.horodatage

SELECT r.patient_id, r.civilite, r.prenom, r.nom, to_char(r.date_naissance, 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS naissance, r.chambre, r.etage, r.diagnostics, r.allergies, r.regime, r.risques, (SELECT string_agg(m.medicament || ' ' || m.dosage || ' (' || m.schema_prise || ')', ' ; ' ORDER BY m.id) FROM soins.plan_medication m WHERE m.patient_id = r.patient_id AND m.actif) AS medication, (SELECT string_agg(to_char(v.horodatage AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') || ' ' || v.type || ' ' || v.valeur || ' ' || v.unite, ' ; ' ORDER BY v.horodatage DESC) FROM (SELECT * FROM soins.signes_vitaux WHERE patient_id = r.patient_id ORDER BY horodatage DESC LIMIT 6) v) AS vitaux, (SELECT max(horodatage) FROM soins.signes_vitaux WHERE patient_id = r.patient_id) AS maj, r.date_admission AS admission FROM soins.residents r ORDER BY r.chambre::int
SELECT s.identifiant, g.nom, s.jeton_hash FROM soins.sessions s JOIN soins.soignants g ON g.identifiant = s.identifiant WHERE s.jeton_hash = $1 AND s.expire_le > now() AND g.actif
